R62.name: The Command
R62.capitalBasis: EU4 1444开局原件记首都为诸圣城（Sarilavhan，4630）。后续沿用作参考位置；尚未查得中央迁都的明确年份。翠玉矿都属于另列的狮令战营与翠玉藩镇线索。

provenance.historyRules: Apply undated top-level fields, then every top-level dated block <= date in chronological order; same-date blocks retain source order. add_core/remove_core never create ownership.
provenance.coordinateSystem: Top-left origin; unscaled decoded provinces.bmp pixels; inclusive bounds.
provenance.provinceIdEncoding: RGB PNG: id = R + 256*G; B = 0; 0 denotes an undefined/background pixel.
provenance.countrySet: Only tags owning at least one on-map, non-water, non-impassable, non-excluded province. Dead/core-only countries are not active countries.
provenance.flags: Static gfx/flags/TAG.tga decoded losslessly to PNG; no dynamic flag-script evaluation.
provenance.verification: Static source and pixel round-trip validation only; not runtime-tested in EU4.
limitations: Country/province initialization scripts, on_actions and triggered effects are not executed.
Dynamic name/color/flag changes and engine-generated countries are not evaluated.
Top-level static controller defaults to owner only when no controller assignment exists.
Map borders remain source pixels, including source irregularities and enclaves.

controlPolicy.initial: raw owner first, otherwise tribal_owner in Gerudia, Escann and explicitly reviewed neighboring provinces
controlPolicy.later: Replay explicit changes only; stale tribal_owner never restores control
controlPolicy.unspecified: Absent owner and tribal_owner means source-unspecified, not uninhabited
